changelog: Updated [When to Segment] to note polarity-setting and reporting surface cues as unstable signals that can overturn earlier assertions (so they remain candidates but are flagged for lower ranking).

Clarified [Priority Rules] to explicitly demote (lower confidence for) boundaries that would assert polarity, existence/quantity, habitual statements, or speaker stance before seeing downstream negation, evaluative predicates, reporting verbs, or a confirmed full proper name.
